title: Chapter 1189 - 10 Fierce Sun, Xuanyin, Chaos (Seeking Subscription)
content:
Chapter 1189 - 10 Fierce Sun, Xuanyin, Chaos (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1189: Chapter 10 Fierce Sun, Xuanyin, Chaos (Seeking Subscription)

"The Fierce Sun Ancient Country, on the grounds that Jihan and Beiyin acted without authorization, seeks either a billion-year stewardship of the ’Infinite Eye’ or one hundred jin of Infinite Crystal."

On the throne, the Emperor of the Xuanyin Ancient Country spoke.

The Infinite Eye is a top-level treasure land of the Xuanyin Ancient Country, producing around ten jin of the rare treasure Infinite Crystal every million years.

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s direct proposal to obtain a billion-year stewardship of the top-level treasure land ’Infinite Eye’ is essentially the same as acquiring a hundred jin of Infinite Crystal.

"The Fierce Sun Ancient Country is going too far. The Infinite Eye is a first-class treasure land, and Jihan and Beiyin merely infiltrated the Hei Yu Nest once. Not to mention they failed, even if they had succeeded, they could at most obtain a single yield from the Hei Yu Nest, yet now they want the extraordinary treasures from ten yields of the ’Infinite Eye’?"

A Heavenly Venerate in luxurious robes spoke.

"It is excessive."

The Emperor of the Xuanyin Ancient Country nodded, "But in this matter, we are at fault first."

Most Heavenly Venerates present remained silent upon hearing this.

The billion-year stewardship of the ’Infinite Eye’ may sound like a huge price, but in truth, for entities at the level of a Heavenly Venerate, a billion years is not significant.

It is not as if the top-level treasure land ’Infinite Eye’ is being completely handed over to the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

"Since none of you have any objections, I will agree to it."

The Emperor of Xuanyin Ancient Country glanced around and spoke.

The many Heavenly Venerates were quiet, with no objections.

"As for the two of you?"

The Emperor of Xuanyin Ancient Country looked at Jihan Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage: "Your punishment is to guard the Gloomy Prison for a billion years."

The Gloomy Prison is connected to a shadowy world inhabited by countless dark creatures.

Guarding such a place is not a pleasant task; the dark creatures are not particularly strong, but they are troublesome and limitless in number, requiring a Heavenly Venerate level strongman to constantly be on alert to suppress them.

Generally, the Xuanyin Ancient Country rewards the Heavenly Venerates who guard the Gloomy Prison with more merits, but Jihan Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage are punished for their own mistakes and naturally receive no rewards for merits.

"Yes."

Although Jihan Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage were unwilling at heart, they still immediately responded.

"And that Galaxy Venerate didn’t even consider it."

Jihan Venerate was angry inside. He and Beiyin had tried negotiating with the Galaxy Venerate, but their demands were outrageously high, requiring the ’Xuanyin Secret Scripture.’

Jihan Venerate refused, and as a result, the Galaxy Venerate simply ceased negotiations, without even considering the terms they proposed.

If the Galaxy Venerate could have struck a deal with them, the two venerates wouldn’t be subjected to such punishment.

...

Qingfen City.

Lord Qingfen was in secluded cultivation when he suddenly opened his eyes, his expression slightly changing.

"Within the Hei Yu Nest, a top-level treasure land at the border of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country and Xuanyin Ancient Country, Jihan Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage infiltrated and were left behind by the Galaxy Guardian."

Lord Qingfen looked at the intelligence information he just received. The existence of Great Lords usually keeps in contact, sharing intelligence with each other.

"Galaxy Guardian?"

"Galaxy?"

Lord Qingfen was somewhat puzzled and continued to read on below: "Galaxy Guardian, a core royal of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, recently appeared in Qingfen City, then proceeded to the capital of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, breaking the ancestral bloodline constraints, achieving the level of a Heavenly Venerate in bloodline..."

The more Lord Qingfen read, the more astonished he became. He had long anticipated that after Lin Yuan went to the capital, he would certainly shine, but did not expect it to be this soon?

How long has it been?

Leaving behind two ancient venerates of the Xuanyin Ancient Country?

Breaking ancestral bloodline constraints?

"Galaxy, this intelligence?" Lord Qingfen immediately proceeded to the Sky Burning Court.

There remained an avatar of Lin Yuan.

"Hahaha, this was spread by the emperor," Lin Yuan glanced over and casually said.

Breaking the constraints of the ancestral bloodline himself has two main impacts on the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

First, given time, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country here will give rise to a strong existence surpassing the Peak Venerable.

Second, the first to break the ancestral bloodline is from the royal family of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, which will have significant repercussions on the other five Ancient Countries.

The significance of the latter even surpasses the former.

Thus, the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country would naturally publicize it.

Of course, the announcement was made with Lin Yuan’s consent.

In fact, even without spreading the news, it would have been meaningless since the Xuanyin Ancient Country already knew. Rather than letting them secretly inherit and distort certain aspects, it was better to openly spread the information.

...

"Galaxy Great Lord... should now be Galaxy Venerate..."

Great Venerate Hongye and many other Great Venerates also successively received this intelligence, expressing deep emotion.

Many Great Venerates had once fought alongside Lin Yuan on the battlefield between the two domains. In the blink of an eye, the Galaxy Great Lord had already become the Galaxy Venerate.

Still, a Heavenly Venerate achieved by the unprecedented ancestral bloodline.

...

Da Ling Ancient Country.

King Spirit Might sat cross-legged in a bamboo grove.

The war between the Purple Dream Domain and Qingfen Domain ended in defeat on his side.

As the initiator of the war, King Spirit Might naturally received punishment, being trapped in the bamboo grove for a billion years, unable to leave.

"Galaxy Venerate?"

King Spirit Might looked at the intelligence before him, somewhat lost in thought.

In that war, he had been confident of victory, but Lin Yuan continually thwarted his plans time and again.

First, he hindered the dominator-level expert sent to infiltrate the Qingfen Domain, shattering the scheme to capture Qingfen Domain with minimal cost by recreating the formation of Qingfen City using the Myriad Formation Crystal.

Later, he single-handedly turned the tide completely on the front battlefield.

"Fate is not with me."

Spirit Might King sighed inwardly. Initially, he thought it was a matter of his strategy, that perhaps inviting one more peak core royal member might have restrained Lin Yuan.

But now, it seems that that galaxy managed to break through the shackles of the Heavenly Venerate bloodline in such a short time, possibly hiding strength at the battlefield then.

Even if Spirit Might King prepared as much as possible, he ultimately failed.

...

"Heavenly Venerate-level ancestor bloodline?"

Compared to Spirit Might King, the peak core royal King Lingshen’s eyes lit up, "Could it be that our royal bloodline can truly be tapped into the Heavenly Venerate level?"

The more one grows to the limit, the more one feels the intangible shackles of the ancestor bloodline. Breaking through these shackles...is as hard as climbing to heaven.

Many core royals cannot see hope, thus they turn to comprehend the Tao rules, eventually realizing the second layer of chaos evolution power, achieving Heavenly Venerate status through this path.

Among the six Ancient Countries, no royal clansmen have birthed Heavenly Venerate level experts, referring to the Heavenly Venerate level of ancestor bloodline.

"Losing to a Heavenly Venerate level ancestor bloodline, no shame in that."

King Lingshen beamed, in terms of path, Lin Yuan’s exploration into the ancestor bloodline is ahead of his.

In this regard, King Lingshen is sincerely convinced.

"Since that galaxy can tap into the ancestor bloodline up to the Heavenly Venerate level, then I can too."

King Lingshen took a deep breath and began once again the cultivation of bloodline enlightenment.

...

Fierce Sun Ancient Country, national treasury.

Lin Yuan was carefully observing the information about numerous treasures and inheritances collected in the treasury.

With a million merit points in hand, Lin Yuan’s standards were a bit higher; he seldom paid attention to inherited treasures worth less than ten thousand merit points.

"Fierce Sun Diagram?"

Lin Yuan looked at one of the inheritances.

Named ’Fierce Sun Diagram.’

This diagram was drawn by a Peak Venerable of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country while possessed by the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, from the Ancestor’s perspective.

It contains various insights and gains of this Peak Venerable after leveraging the Ancestor’s perspective.

"Of no use to me."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. For other Heavenly Venerates and even Peak Venerables, this Fierce Sun Diagram holds significant reference value.

After all, it is the insight from being possessed by an ancestor from the same level. Even though he had been possessed himself, it is still necessary to reference it.

Moreover, since the ancestor level is so high, understanding these Fierce Sun Diagrams before being possessed can serve as a ’precaution.’

But for Lin Yuan?

With Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, it’s not necessary.

Even if a Twelfth Layer life is possessed by a Thirteenth Layer time life, what it sees, feels, and knows may not be correct. Watching this kind of Fierce Sun Diagram holds little significance for Lin Yuan.

Spending energy on it is less direct than being possessed by an ancestor.

At least it avoids ’distractions,’ ’misguidance.’

Also, this Fierce Sun Diagram is too expensive; any random one costs several millions of merit points, something Lin Yuan cannot currently afford.

"’Fierce Sun, Xuanyin, Chaos.’"

Lin Yuan focused on another inheritance, founded by an ancient Peak Venerable of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country who had reached the third layer on the path of chaos evolution, walking the chaos intense sun path.

After reaching the third layer of the chaos intense sun path, this Peak Venerable began trying to incorporate the Xuanyin path, aiming to traverse the chaos Xuanyin path, thereby combining the two.

"This inheritance somewhat resembles my path."

Lin Yuan felt moved in his heart. The path he traverses, Chaos Yin Yang Taiji, corresponds to Chaos Intense Sun Xuanyin. Though different, they broadly belong to the same type? Comprehending this inheritance not only benefits his evolution of Chaos Yin Yang Taiji but also provides high guidance value for future cultivation.

The path of chaos evolution power is divided into three layers, becoming harder as it progresses.

With previous roads for reference, Lin Yuan’s cultivation would be easier, and the most crucial point—prevent wandering.

After all, predecessors have tried it.

"One million eight hundred thousand merit points?"

Lin Yuan glanced at the merit required for this inheritance, his brows slightly furrowed.

Currently, his merit points are a little over one million, the excess part accumulated over recent times.

"It seems I still need to gather eighty hundred thousand merit points." Lin Yuan sighed.

Although eager to comprehend this inheritance, without enough merit, there’s no choice.

"Galaxy." Just then, the voice of the emperor of Fierce Sun Ancient Country suddenly emerged.

As emperor, he could contact Lin Yuan even in the treasury space.

"The side of Xuanyin Ancient Country agreed to relinquish the first-class sacred land ’Infinite Eye’ for ten billion years."

"Our Fierce Sun Ancient Country is expected to obtain about a hundred jin of Infinite Crystal, equivalent to another million merit points for you."

"A million merit points?" Lin Yuan immediately noticed his merit count changing from over one million to over two million.

"Just in time."

Lin Yuan eyed the inheritance ’Fierce Sun, Xuanyin, Chaos,’ now having enough merit points to exchange for this inheritance.

"Exchange."

Lin Yuan instantly activated his thought.

Buzz!

Soon, a vast amount of information flooded into Lin Yuan’s mind.
